added_meaning: Selected Senate 90005(a) funding and its own program context follow. Senate 90005(a) paragraph 1: In addition to amounts otherwise available, there is appropriated to the Administrator of the Federal Emergency Management Agency for fiscal year 2025, out of any money in the Treasury not otherwise appropriated, to remain available until September 30, 2029, to be administered under the State Homeland Security Grant Program authorized under section 2004 of the Homeland Security Act of 2002 (6 U.S.C. 605), to enhance State, local, and Tribal security through grants, contracts, cooperative agreements, and other activities-- Senate 90005(a) purpose A: $500,000,000 for State and local capabilities to detect, identify, track, or monitor threats from unmanned aircraft systems (as such term is defined in section 44801 of title 49, United States Code), consistent with titles 18 and 49 of the United States Code; Senate 90005(a) purpose B: $625,000,000 for security and other costs related to the 2026 FIFA World Cup; Senate 90005(a) purpose C: $1,000,000,000 for security, planning, and other costs related to the 2028 Olympics; and Senate 90005(a) purpose D: $450,000,000 for the Operation Stonegarden Grant Program. Senate 90005(a) paragraph 2: None of the funds made available under subparagraph (B) or (C) of paragraph (1) shall be subject to the requirements of section 2004(e)(1) or section 2008(a)(12) of the Homeland Security Act of 2002 (6 U.S.C. 605(e)(1), 609(a)(12)). The pre-vote fiscal year 2024 DHS/FEMA HSGP notice reproduced on Hawaii's official host describes Operation Stonegarden as supporting enhanced cooperation and coordination among CBP, USBP, and Federal, State, local, Tribal and territorial law enforcement agencies to improve overall border security. It funds joint border-security efforts along routes of ingress and egress to and from international borders, including travel corridors in States bordering Mexico and Canada and States and territories with international water borders. In that notice, those State, local, Tribal and territorial law enforcement agencies use their inherent law enforcement authorities and receive no additional authority from participating in Stonegarden. This is dated program-purpose context, not a new power conferred by the Senate appropriation or a complete 2025 eligibility rule. The additional fiscal year 2025 appropriation names FEMA Administrator, availability until September 30, 2029, administration under the State Homeland Security Grant Program in 6 U.S.C. 605, and State/local/Tribal security through grants, contracts, cooperative agreements and other activities. The Stonegarden purpose is $450,000,000 within that administration provision. The drone-threat, FIFA and Olympics purposes retain their own printed objects and amounts as adjacent context; those purposes alone do not establish an immigration purpose. The exemption from 605(e)(1) minimum allocation and 609(a)(12) grant-administration expense cap expressly names only FIFA paragraph (1)(B) and Olympics paragraph (1)(C); no exemption for Stonegarden paragraph (1)(D) or drone paragraph (1)(A) is inferred. Captured 605(e)(1) retains its State and named-territory minimum-allocation branches, own fiscal-year denominators and percentages; captured 609(a)(12) permits expenses directly related to grant administration except that such expenses may not exceed 3 percent of the grant amount. Neither this cap nor those minima are reclassified as the separate 90005(b) FEMA one-percent ceiling. Complete captured 603, 605 and 609 retain their own program relationships, application/distribution/multistate rules, permitted-use and personnel/construction/recreation restrictions, waivers, reimbursement, transfers and equipment requirements. Their application to a particular 2025 Stonegarden award, including interaction with the dated 2024 notice's separate HSGP components and conditions, is reserved as question 52. No 2024 funding amount, application deadline, performance period, subrecipient tier or approval automatically governs this new appropriation. No particular State/local/Tribal award, entitlement, expenditure, additional law-enforcement power or individual status result is inferred. Other package components and all previously reserved application questions remain unfinished.
